scenes.say: Four hundred and eighteen thousand pieces. That's the car built for the Vegas podium.
In twenty twenty-five a pink convertible drove Verstappen, Norris and Russell to the podium. Terry Crews was at the wheel.
It was inspired by a nineteen fifties Cadillac. Seventeen builders, nearly four thousand hours, over two tonnes.
On Saturday, before the race, eleven brick-built F1 cars hit the track, one per team.
One lap, up to twenty-five kilometres an hour. Who's driving is still a secret.
And in F1 Academy, Dutch driver Esmee Kosterman races for the LEGO team this season.
Follow Saturday night's race on the LapRadar live map.

title: LEGO and Las Vegas: a pink Cadillac for the podium and brick-built F1 cars on the Strip
